metadata.author: Research Team
metadata.description: Proteus coding task with post-survey only

pre_survey.title: Pre-Study Survey
pre_survey.description: No pre-survey required for this assignment.

post_survey.title: Post-Study Survey
post_survey.description: Thank you for completing the task! Please share your experience with the AI coding assistant. All questions are required.

questions.question: How much do you trust CodeOracle generated code suggestions?
questions.help_text: 1 = Strongly distrust, 2 = Distrust, 3 = Neither trust nor distrust, 4 = Trust, 5 = Strongly trust

questions.question: Please describe why you trust or distrust CodeOracle in your own words.
questions.placeholder: Describe the factors that influenced your trust or distrust in CodeOracle during this assignment...

questions.question: Please describe in your own words, how CodeOracle generates code suggestions?
questions.placeholder: Explain your understanding of how CodeOracle generates code suggestions...

questions.question: How do you think GitHub Copilot learns from both your code and code written by other developers?
questions.placeholder: Describe your understanding of how Copilot learns from data...

questions.question: How accurate do you believe CodeOracle generated code suggestions are?
questions.help_text: Move the slider to indicate your perceived accuracy (0% = completely inaccurate, 100% = perfectly accurate)

questions.question: Why do you believe CodeOracle-generated code might be incorrect?
questions.placeholder: Explain your reasoning about why AI-generated code suggestions might be incorrect...

questions.question: How do you think CodeOracle generated code suggestions affect your ability to complete programming assignments?
questions.placeholder: Describe how CodeOracle's suggestions affected your programming performance...

questions.question: The CodeOracle appeared to understand my goals really well.
questions.help_text: 1 = Strongly disagree, 2 = Disagree, 3 = Neither agree nor disagree, 4 = Agree, 5 = Strongly agree

questions.question: The CodeOracle system provides next-line code suggestions. Share your overall experience with how this system helped or hindered you in solving the programming assignment.
questions.placeholder: Describe your overall experience with CodeOracle during this assignment...

questions.question: Seeing only the next line code suggestions was:
questions.help_text: 1 = Very unhelpful, 2 = Unhelpful, 3 = Neither helpful nor unhelpful, 4 = Helpful, 5 = Very helpful

questions.question: Explain how you used the next-line code suggestions during the activity.
questions.placeholder: Describe how you used the next-line code suggestions...

questions.question: Would you continue to use this tool, why or why not?
questions.placeholder: Explain whether you would use this tool again and your reasoning...

questions.question: In this system, the AI coding assistant provided next-line code suggestions of the problem you are attempting to solve. How often was the AI's understanding different from your intention, and how did you interpret those misalignments?
questions.placeholder: Describe instances where the AI's understanding differed from yours and how you dealt with it...

questions.question: Has using this tool helped you to change your view on how AI coding assistants work, and if so, why?
questions.placeholder: Reflect on whether and how your understanding of AI assistants has changed...

questions.question: What suggestions do you have for improving this tool?
questions.placeholder: Share your ideas for how this AI coding assistant could be improved...

questions.question: How difficult did you find this assignment?
questions.help_text: 1 = Very easy, 2 = Easy, 3 = Moderate, 4 = Difficult, 5 = Very difficult
